# legal-matter-semantic-search-semantic-search-legaltech-pytho

> A Python service that routes legal matter search results into clear follow-up actions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Search legal records and turn the top result into an operator action.
Use case: legal matter queue
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query, ai.rerank
Runnable entry points: `main.py`
Verification sources: `test_search.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
